objections.finding: BA spec does not document an explicit rollback procedure. Architect's blast_radius.rollback_strategy ('git checkout of 2-3 files + daemon rebuild') should be incorporated into the spec's Pre-Flight Checklist or a new Rollback section.
objections.recommendation: Add a one-sentence rollback note: 'If post-restart journalctl shows [CodexAppServer] Error lines or AC6 fails, Dev runs: cd ${WORKTREE_PATH} && git checkout HEAD -- packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codexAppServerClient.ts packages/happy-cli/src/codex/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts packages/happy-app/sources/components/tools/knownTools.tsx, then rebuild + restart.'

objections.finding: AC6 only checks bundle presence of existing discriminator strings — not a live regression test. This is acceptable per cycle 1 DORMANT precedent but leaves a blind spot.
objections.recommendation: If a dev Codex session becomes available during Dev/QA, QA should open one existing session and verify CodexBash/CodexPatch/agent_message still render. If not available, bundle-grep is the fallback.

objections.finding: BA spec §179-181 documents that /root/happy-dev is a symlink to /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev (main repo), NOT to the worktree. The spec leaves Dev to choose between (a) building in the main-repo path or (b) copying worktree dist/ into main repo. This is a concrete operational decision that should be resolved in the spec, not deferred to Dev.
objections.recommendation: Pick one: 'Dev MUST run yarn build in ${WORKTREE_PATH}/packages/happy-cli, then cp -r ${WORKTREE_PATH}/packages/happy-cli/dist/* /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/ — the main-repo dist/ is what the daemon binary loads.' Dev then proceeds with cgroup-safe restart.

objections.finding: AC7 (§5.17 markdown regression verification on desktop + mobile) is bundled into this pipeline but is orthogonal to the Codex protocol-extension primary task. It inflates the QA checklist without relating to Dev's changes.
objections.recommendation: Consider moving AC7 to a separate QA-only verification pass or a secondary pipeline. If kept, note that it is a regression check for unrelated prior work and should not block the cycle 2 primary verdict.
